row.notes: The main 3D view's call to Render_SceneView_BuildViewParams (rcx = view params block). Realistic Rain matches a hook's return address (site+5) to keep only the main camera. | 2026-11-21 raised to L2 (gh:vogtmarcel07-cloud, body read): 0x140157d90 (pdata ..0x140158a63, only caller 0x1401508d8 in 0x14014d230) loops r15 over the viewports ([[rcx+0x88]+0x40] vector, 0x110-byte entries, count at 0x140157e13..0x140157e24) and per viewport ends in this one E8 call: rcx = [rsi+(r15+6)*8+0x168] (the viewport's scene-view params, 0x1401583c1/0x1401583c5 or 0x140158150/0x140158154) and rdx = either the camera desc built on the stack (rbx = rsp+0xa0, 0x140157e52) or the stored camera [rsi+r15*8+0x168]+0x10 (0x14015815c..0x140158164, then jmp 0x140158168 to the call). Both paths reach 0x1401583d0 at its first byte; no branch lands inside 0x1401583d1..0x1401583d4. After the call 0x1401583d5 tests [rsi+r15*4+0xaf4] and loops back to 0x140157e81. So a launcher site hook here sees exactly the main scene views' Render_SceneView_BuildViewParams results (params+0x80 and +0xc0 hold the two 4x4 matrices it writes), which is what the race-start / cool-down board overlay patches the rel32 for today.
